title: Reading hack
subtitle: For Kindle users...
html:
If you’re like me, you want to read more.

If you’re also like me, you probably have a Kindle.

Problem is, the Kindle and iPad are always nearly dead.

So, to get around this, I started using the Kindle web app on my laptop.

As you’re crushing work from your computer, you can now pepper more reading in throughout your day.

To go next level, have the Kindle web app bookmarked in the bookmarks bar.

  • Have 20 spare minutes between meetings? Read.

  • Taking a break between projects? Read.

  • Hit inbox 0? Read.

Try it out.
